component.name: ProbeScene
component.script:
sub init() root = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") counts = [20, 2, 30, 2] for r = 0 to counts.count() - 1 row = root.createChild("ContentNode") for c = 0 to counts[r] - 1 row.createChild("ContentNode").title = "R" + r.toStr() + " I" + c.toStr() end for end for rows = m.top.findNode("rows") rows.content = root rows.observeField("rowItemFocused", "onRowItemFocused") rows.observeField("currFocusColumn", "onColumn") end sub
sub onStyle() rows = m.top.findNode("rows") rows.rowFocusAnimationStyle = m.top.style m.top.findNode("caption").text = "rowFocusAnimationStyle = " + m.top.style rows.setFocus(true) end sub
sub onRowItemFocused() f = m.top.findNode("rows").rowItemFocused print "PROBE|rowItemFocused=" + f[0].toStr() + "," + f[1].toStr() end sub
sub onColumn() print "PROBE|currFocusColumn=" + Str(m.top.findNode("rows").currFocusColumn).trim() end sub
